summary: The appellant was removed from membership of the Shakti Nagar Co-operative House Building Society by a resolution dated 11.04.2022, confirmed by the Registrar on 20.06.2022, for alleged default in instalments. She says she paid Rs. 7,80,000 and holds receipts.
directions: The society shall not allot Flat No. B-204 to any other person till further orders.
